_comment: Template. Copy to memory.json and write your own facts. memory.json is gitignored so your personal details never leave your machine.
facts: Your name and where you are based.
What you do for work, and the companies involved.
Languages you speak, and which one to default to.
Tools you use daily, so it does not explain the basics to you.
How you like it to respond, for example action first, short answers.
